title: Blackstone Adopts Factory for Autonomous AI Software Development
summary:
An autonomous coding platform is being integrated into the data centers of the world's largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone is using software from Factory to automate its development processes while retaining full control over governance, engineering workflows, and model choice.

President Jon Gray has described this shift toward artificial intelligence as the biggest bet of his career. The firm selected Factory after trialing several different platforms to find one that could support its large scale enterprise requirements.
